Reference Annual p.85 and NBT p.3 read in extracted PDF text; no imagery or lyrics reproduced. NBT spells the leader Dhayananda, Ministry spells Dhyanananda; preserved separately, no identity or continuous membership assertion.
Ministry entry592 text verified; video link not opened or normalised. No recording audition.

Current academy operations, maker livelihoods, performer fees and training outcomes.
